evidence.note: Command switch dispatches each supported command.

runInit writes or replaces the managed Codex AGENTS.md section.
Tests cover AGENTS.md creation.

runInit dispatches --agent claude to safe Claude skill creation/update logic.

claim: projnavi onboard scans relevant repo files, note files, claims, and glossary paths to write manifest hashes and inventory.

evidence.note: scanForManifest builds file, note, evidence, and inventory manifest data.

claim: projnavi guide builds task briefs by ranking claims, glossary terms, and notes, then emitting read-first items, concepts, tests, warnings, stale warnings, and evidence.

evidence.note: Guide command loads data, verifies freshness, and formats the brief.

evidence.note: Tests assert concise JSON output, read-first items, glossary concepts, suggested tests, evidence, and alias matching.

claim: projnavi verify recomputes hashes for tracked and referenced files, reports changed or missing evidence, and marks related claims stale.

Test mutates an evidence file and expects stale claim reporting.

claim: Claim, glossary, and manifest schema types and validators live in src/core/schemas.ts.

evidence.note: TypeScript interfaces define claims, glossary, and manifest data.
validateClaim enforces claim JSONL schema.

claim: scripts/compare-guide.mjs compares dry-run investigation with and without projnavi and reports context-size reduction metrics.
